reuse.why: All providers share the new guards and existing bank lookup, but Fintegra copies the linking workflow and transaction downloader, while replacement repeats unlink cleanup.

duplication.why: The diff adds three duplicated logic blocks: account linking, transaction downloading, and local unlink cleanup.

placement.why: Provider integration follows the existing module boundaries, although a validation helper now also performs unlink mutations.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option, and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Centralized guards help maintenance, but copied workflows and unlink mutations hidden behind ensureAccountIsNotLinked increase the cost of future changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every provider uses the shared linking guards and findOrCreateBank; the existing unlinkAccount action includes remote cleanup and is not directly suitable for replacement.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount repeats the existing provider linking workflow under Fintegra names, and downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing transaction-download flow without sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a conditional unlink mutation, expanding a validation helper into a state-changing operation; all six provider handlers still call it.
